svg.text: christmas-bell-tht on a perfboard (Lochraster, a pad per hole)
top view – component side, A1 at the top left
Prototype of docs/concepts/new/perfboard-layout.md – drawn by perfboard.py, not by edakit
Parts as seen from above; insulated wires in their colour, entering the board at the dots. The bridges are in the bottom view.
LED: flat side = cathode, + = anode (long lead). C1: stripe = minus. J1: 1 GND (brown), 2 +5V, 3 signal.
Dashed circles: nut of the M3 mounting holes.
